cases.translation: Let them share with the nearest neighbor.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Eat the meat roasted over fire.
cases.explain: The preposition над governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Eat it with bread made without leaven.
cases.explain: The preposition без governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: В эту ночь я пройду по ___.
cases.translation: On that night I will pass through Egypt.
cases.explain: The preposition по governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал ___ и Аарону в Египте.
cases.translation: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron in Egypt.
cases.explain: The verb сказать (to speak to someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.translation: Dip it in the blood that is in the basin.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: Moses called the elders of Israel.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb призвать takes the accusative; for an animate plural noun it equals the genitive plural form.

cases.sentence: Идите, выберите ягня и заколите пасхальную ___.
cases.translation: Go, choose a lamb and kill the Passover sacrifice.
cases.explain: The direct object of the transitive verb заколоть takes the accusative case.

reading.ru: Израилетяне прожили в Египте четыреста тридцать лет.
reading.question: How long did the Israelites live in Egypt?
reading.explain: The text says 'Израилетяне прожили в Египте четыреста тридцать лет' (the Israelites lived in Egypt four hundred thirty years).

reading.ru: Не ломайте ни одной из костей.
reading.question: What were they commanded regarding the bones of the sacrifice?
options: Do not break any of its bones
reading.correct: Do not break any of its bones
reading.explain: The text commands 'Не ломайте ни одной из костей' (do not break any of the bones).

reading.ru: Египтяне торопили народ покинуть страну, иначе, говорили они, мы все умрем.
reading.question: Why did the Egyptians hurry the people to leave?
options: They feared that otherwise they would all die
They needed the land for farming
reading.correct: They feared that otherwise they would all die
reading.explain: The Egyptians said 'мы все умрем' (we will all die) if the people did not leave.

reading.question: How did the people respond?
options: They bowed down and worshiped the Lord
reading.correct: They bowed down and worshiped the Lord
reading.explain: The text says 'Народ склонился и восславил Господа' (the people bowed and worshiped the Lord).

reading.ru: Эту жертву следует есть в том доме, где ее приготовили.
reading.question: Where was the Passover sacrifice to be eaten?
options: In the same house where it was prepared
reading.correct: In the same house where it was prepared
reading.explain: The text says it must be eaten 'в том доме, где ее приготовили' (in the house where it was prepared).

reading.question: Who was not permitted to eat the Passover?
reading.explain: The text says 'Ее не может есть чужеземец' (a foreigner may not eat of it).
